faq.q: How do I apply for admission to ASPU?
faq.a: Apply through the university's online admission portal at admission.asu.edu.jo. You'll need to upload your Tawjihi certificate, ID, and personal photo. The portal lets you track your application status and complete registration steps. For inquiries, WhatsApp: 00962775778804 or 00962779966698.
faq.qa: كيف أقدم على جامعة العلوم التطبيقية؟
faq.aa: التقديم من خلال منصة القبول الإلكترونية على admission.asu.edu.jo. بتحتاج ترفع شهادة التوجيهي، الهوية، وصورة شخصية. المنصة بتخليك تتابع حالة طلبك وتكمل خطوات التسجيل. للاستفسار واتساب: 00962775778804 أو 00962779966698.

faq.q: What documents do I need for registration?
faq.a: Original Tawjihi certificate, national ID or passport, personal photos, and proof of fee payment. International students may need additional documents for residency.
faq.aa: شهادة التوجيهي الأصلية، الهوية أو جواز السفر، صور شخصية، وإثبات دفع الرسوم. الطلاب الدوليين ممكن يحتاجوا وثائق إضافية للإقامة.

faq.q: Is there a registration fee?
faq.a: Yes, registration fees apply. However, ASPU frequently runs promotions offering 100% exemption from registration fees during specific enrollment periods. Check the admission portal or contact the Admissions Office for current offers.
faq.aa: نعم، في رسوم تسجيل. بس الجامعة بتعمل عروض متكررة بإعفاء 100% من رسوم التسجيل خلال فترات تسجيل محددة. تحقق من منصة القبول أو تواصل مع دائرة القبول والتسجيل للعروض الحالية.

faq.q: What is the minimum attendance requirement?
faq.a: You must attend at least 75% of lectures for each course. Falling below this may result in being barred from the final exam (DN grade).
faq.aa: لازم تحضر 75% على الأقل من محاضرات كل مادة. إذا نزلت عن هالنسبة ممكن تتحرم من الامتحان النهائي (علامة DN).

faq.q: Are there merit-based scholarships for new students?
faq.a: Yes. ASPU offers partial scholarships up to 50% based on Tawjihi grades. There are also special scholarships for top IT students (100%, 75%, 50%, 30% for ranks 1-10). Check the admission portal for the current scholarship brackets.
faq.qa: هل في منح للطلاب المتفوقين الجدد؟
faq.aa: نعم. الجامعة بتقدم منح جزئية تصل إلى 50% حسب معدل التوجيهي. كمان في منح خاصة لطلاب تكنولوجيا المعلومات المتميزين (100%، 75%، 50%، 30% للمراكز 1-10). تحقق من منصة القبول لشرائح المنح الحالية.

faq.q: What is MY ASU and what can I do with it?
faq.a: MY ASU (my.asu.edu.jo) is the student services portal. You can register for courses, view grades, check attendance, manage finances, and access your academic plan. There's also a mobile app for iOS and Android.
faq.qa: شو هي MY ASU وشو بقدر أعمل فيها؟
faq.aa: MY ASU (my.asu.edu.jo) هي بوابة الخدمات الطلابية. بتقدر تسجل مواد، تشوف علاماتك، تتابع غياباتك، تدير أمورك المالية، وتوصل لخطتك الدراسية. في كمان تطبيق للموبايل على iOS و Android.

faq.q: What is EduGate and how do I use it?
faq.a: EduGate (edugate.asu.edu.jo) is the university's asynchronous learning platform. Course materials, assignments, quizzes, and exams are posted here. You log in with your university email and password.
faq.aa: EduGate (edugate.asu.edu.jo) هي منصة التعلم غير المتزامن. مواد المساقات، الواجبات، الاختبارات القصيرة، والامتحانات بتنزل هنا. بتسجل دخول بالإيميل الجامعي وكلمة المرور.

faq.q: How do I register for level exams?
faq.a: You can register for level exams (placement tests) by paying the fee on campus, or electronically via eFAWATEERcom. Steps: 1) Go to the registration link and generate a payment number. 2) Use eFAWATEERcom or your banking app: Education Sector > Applied Science University > Other Fees Services. 3) After payment, check your exam date within 30 minutes on the inquiry page.
faq.aa: بتقدر تسجل لامتحانات المستوى بدفع الرسوم داخل الحرم الجامعي، أو إلكترونياً عبر إي فواتيركم. الخطوات: 1) ادخل على رابط التسجيل واصدر رقم دفع. 2) استخدم إي فواتيركم أو تطبيق البنك: القطاع التعليمي > جامعة العلوم التطبيقية > خدمات رسوم أخرى. 3) بعد الدفع، تحقق من موعد الامتحان خلال نصف ساعة من صفحة الاستعلام.

faq.q: How do I access the campus Wi-Fi?
faq.a: Select the ASPU-Student network and log in with your university email and password. Wi-Fi is available in all academic buildings, the library, and common areas.
faq.aa: اختر شبكة ASPU-Student وسجل دخول بالإيميل الجامعي وكلمة المرور. الواي فاي متوفر في كل المباني الأكاديمية والمكتبة والمناطق العامة.

faq.q: How many credit hours do I need to graduate?
faq.a: It varies by program. Most bachelor's programs require 120-135 credit hours. For example, Nursing requires 135 credit hours. Check your specific study plan in the student portal.
faq.aa: بتختلف حسب التخصص. معظم برامج البكالوريوس بتطلب 120-135 ساعة معتمدة. مثلاً التمريض بحتاج 135 ساعة. تحقق من خطتك الدراسية في بوابة الطالب.

faq.q: What GPA do I need to avoid academic probation?
faq.a: You need a cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 out of 4.0. Falling below this places you on academic probation, and you'll have limited credit hours until your GPA improves.
faq.qa: شو المعدل اللي بحتاجه لتجنب الإنذار الأكاديمي؟
faq.aa: لازم يكون معدلك التراكمي 2.0 من 4.0 على الأقل. إذا نزلت عن هالمعدل بتصير تحت الإنذار الأكاديمي، وبتكون ساعاتك محدودة لحد ما يتحسن معدلك.

faq.q: What is the Add/Drop period?
faq.a: The first two weeks of the semester where you can add or drop courses without academic or financial penalties. After this period, withdrawals count as 'W' on your transcript.
faq.aa: أول أسبوعين من الفصل، بتقدر تضيف أو تحذف مواد بدون غرامات أكاديمية أو مالية. بعد هالفترة، السحب بيتسجل 'W' على كشف علاماتك.

faq.q: What is UniHub?
faq.a: UniHub is a comprehensive online resource for students and educators, offering an extensive collection of test banks, PDFs, and quizzes.

faq.q: How can I access the test banks?

faq.q: Are the test banks free to use?
faq.a: Yes, all resources on UniHub are completely free to use.

faq.q: Can I contribute my own test banks or quizzes?
faq.a: Yes, UniHub encourages contributions from students and educators. You can upload your own test banks or quizzes by following the submission guidelines on the website.

faq.q: Is UniHub mobile-friendly?
faq.a: Yes, the website is designed to be fully responsive and mobile-friendly, ensuring a seamless experience on all devices.

faq.q: Is there an iOS app for UniHub?
faq.a: There might be an iOS app in the future if students are willing to donate to support its development. Stay tuned for updates!

faq.q: Is there an Android app for UniHub?

head.sub: What UniHub collects, why, and how to delete it.
head.ar: ما الذي يجمعه بنك ASU ولماذا وكيف تحذفه.

b.p: UniHub is a free, volunteer, student-run project. It is not made by or owned by Applied Science Private University. Questions go to necro144@yahoo.com.

b.h: What we collect when you make an account

b.p: Username, display name and a scrambled copy of your password.
Only if you add them: email, university ID, phone number, profile photo, bio, major, college, year and interests.
Your chat messages, posts and likes, your friends and friend requests, pokes you send and get, who you blocked, when you were last active, the reports you send and the group links you ask us to add.

Your name, username, photo, bio, major, college, year, interests, badges, posts, how many friends you have and when you were last online. Your phone number shows only if you turn that on. Your email and university ID are visible only to you and the admins.

When you share a post or story with everyone, anyone can see it on the website and in the apps, also without an account, along with your name, photo and badges. Posts and stories shared with ASU students or friends only, and the rest of your profile, stay for signed-in people.

Private messages and their files are seen only by you and the person you write to. They are stored on our Google account and are not end-to-end encrypted. They can be looked at when someone reports a message.

b.h: What you send us without an account

b.p: Files you upload, teacher ratings, course matcher forms and material requests go to our Google Drive and Sheets, with the details you type in. Don’t put your name or student ID in files you upload.

Files you submit for the campus screen go to a separate folder in our Google Drive, and anyone with the link can open them. Photoshoot bookings send your name, phone, email and session details to the photographer.
Search text the app can’t translate by itself goes to Google Translate through our server, without your account.

When you accept the Terms of Service we record the version, the date and time, a random device code made by the app, and the app version. With an account, this is linked to it. We keep it to show that you accepted.

A report keeps what you wrote, and any screenshot you add, in a private folder only admins can open. If you hide your name on a report, admins see a code instead of your account, so you can still follow it under My reports.

b.h: Where it is kept and who gets it

b.p: Your data is stored on Google services (Sheets, Drive and Apps Script) in the project owner’s account. Only admins can open it. We don’t sell it or use it for advertising. We may share information with the authorities when the law requires it or when someone’s safety is at risk.

The Home screen’s weather comes from Open-Meteo, which is asked about the campus only and never about you or your location. On the website your browser makes this request itself, so Open-Meteo sees your internet address, as any website you load does. Your lectures, tab bar and sounds stay on your phone.
The apps have no analytics. The website uses Google Analytics to count visits.
Some pages of the website may show ads from Google AdSense. Ad money goes to the person who runs UniHub. The apps have no ads.

Google and its partners may use cookies to show ads, including ads based on your visits to this and other websites. You can turn off personalized ads in Google’s Ads Settings, and read how Google uses data on sites that use its services.
